text: Gardening comprises several important actions, such as watering, pruning, and planting. Watering is the initial operation to maintain the soil in a damp yet not waterlogged state, as well as the correct pH level. Pruning is the second step, vital for fostering healthy growth and maintaining the overall structure of plants. It includes removing dead or diseased branches, trimming long stems, and eliminating weak or damaged leaves. Planting seeds or seedlings necessitates careful attention to ensure optimal growing conditions, including the right soil type, spacing, and quantity of sunlight. By performing these tasks accurately, one can cultivate a flourishing and vibrant garden.
